summary.text: Joseph J. Solomon Jr. is a Democrat who has represented House District 22 in Warwick since being first elected in November 2014, and who chairs the House Corporations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Solomon also serves on the House Oversight Committee and the House Veterans' Affairs Committee.

His biography lists legislation he sponsored on licensing internationally trained physicians (2025), the state's banking tax apportionment (2024), personal-needs allowances for nursing home residents (2023), catalytic converter theft (2022), and the Rhode Island Small Business Development Fund (2019); it says he co-chairs a commission studying the decline of the state's quahog catch.
Solomon is an attorney and business owner licensed in Rhode Island, Massachusetts and the District of Columbia.

He was born September 4, 1983, graduated from Bishop Hendricken High School in 2001, received a bachelor's degree in accounting from Providence College in 2005 and a J.D. from New England Law Boston in 2008, and lives in Warwick with his wife Sarah.
